comment: AISI 304 austenitic stainless steel, annealed. Density 7.90 g/cm3: Wikipedia 'SAE 304 stainless steel' (7,900 kg/m3). Hardness 201 HB: the maximum ASTM A240 allows for annealed 304 plate, a public specification limit (real stock is often softer). kc1.1 2300 N/mm2: approximate, ISO 513 group M. Cutting data for this material are in the tools' presets.
name: 304 (annealed)
